item.title: Cheeseburger Bowls
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground beef - 500g
  • Potatoes (or fries) - 400g
  • Cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Lettuce - 1–2 cups (shredded)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)

Burger Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp

Directions

  1. Cook potatoes or fries until crispy
  2. Cook ground beef with salt and pepper until browned
  3. Mix burger sauce ingredients in a bowl
  4. Assemble bowls with potatoes, beef, cheese, lettuce, onion, and pickles
  5. Drizzle with burger sauce and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 40g
  • Carbs - 35g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Identified as cheeseburger-style bowl based on user verification
  • Typical “burger in a bowl” structure (beef + potato base + sauce)

item.title: Chicken & Chorizo One Pan Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (diced)
  • Chorizo - 120–150g (sliced)
  • Rice - 250–300g (uncooked, rinsed)
  • Onion - 1 (diced)
  • Red and yellow peppers - 2 (chopped)
  • Garlic - 3 cloves (minced)
  • Chicken stock - 500–700ml
  • Tomato paste - 2 tbsp
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Smoked paprika - 2 tsp
  • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Chilli (optional)

Directions

  1. Heat oil in a large pan and cook chorizo until it releases oils
  2. Add onion, peppers, and garlic, cooking until softened
  3. Add chicken and cook until browned
  4. Stir in tomato paste and seasoning
  5. Add rice and mix to coat in flavours
  6. Pour in chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  7. Cover and cook for 15–20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid absorbed
  8. Fluff and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 600
  • Protein - 45g
  • Carbs - 60g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel + multiple matching recipes :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}
  • Similar to simplified paella-style cooking (one-pan absorption method)
  • Very strong meal prep option

item.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1.3kg chicken breast
  • Taco seasoning
  • 500g low-fat cottage cheese
  • 2 tbsp ranch seasoning
  • 1 tsp chipotle in adobo
  • Juice of ½ lime
  • 2 garlic cloves
  • 45ml light mayonnaise
  • 200g light mozzarella
  • 8 bacon rashers, cooked and diced
  • Chives
  • 1kg cooked rice
  • 10 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Season and cook the chicken, then dice it.
  2. Blend cottage cheese, ranch seasoning, chipotle, lime, garlic and mayonnaise until smooth.
  3. Combine chicken with the ranch sauce, mozzarella, bacon and chives.
  4. Warm each tortilla, add rice and chicken filling, then roll tightly.
  5. Toast immediately or wrap and freeze for later.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Chicken Gnocchi Soup
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
  • Tomato puree - 3 tbsp
  • Sun dried tomatoes - 6 (chopped)
  • Chicken stock - 1L
  • Natural yogurt - 500g
  • Parmesan - 50g (grated)
  • Gnocchi - 400g
  • Spinach - 1 handful
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook the chicken in a pot until lightly browned, then remove and chop if needed
  2. Add the tomato puree and sun dried tomatoes and cook briefly
  3. Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  4. Add the gnocchi and cook until tender
  5. Lower the heat and stir through the yogurt and Parmesan
  6. Return the chicken to the pot and add the spinach
  7. Simmer gently until the spinach wilts and the soup is hot throughout
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 490 per serving
  • Protein - 52g
  • Carbs - 48g
  • Fat - 10g

Notes

  • Macros come from the reel caption

item.title: Chorizo Smash Breakfast Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chorizo - 300g
  • Small tortillas - 6
  • Eggs - 3
  • Cheddar cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Bacon - 3–4 rashers (optional)
  • Onion - 1 (caramelised)

Sauce (optional)

  • Mayonnaise
  • Hot sauce
  • Mustard or similar tangy sauce

Directions

  1. Press chorizo directly onto tortillas in a thin layer
  2. Cook meat-side down in a hot pan until crispy
  3. Flip tortillas and crack egg on top (or cook eggs separately)
  4. Add cheese and allow to melt
  5. Top with bacon and caramelised onion
  6. Fold and serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 620
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel description :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • “Smash taco” method = meat pressed into tortilla and cooked together
  • Breakfast-focused variation of viral smash taco trend

item.title: Giant Chicken Poppers
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken mince - 500g
  • Lite Laughing Cow Cheese - 4 wedges
  • Cornflakes - 60g
  • Greek Yogurt - 150g
  • Seasoning
    • Buffalo Chicken
    • Garlic
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Mix chicken mince with seasonings in a large glass bowl
  2. Cover a piece of cheese with mince mix and roll into a ball
  3. Make more balls with cheese in the middle until the mince is gone
  4. Place the balls into the freezer for 30-60 minutes
  5. Blend the cornflakes with additional seasoning
  6. Roll the chicken balls in Greek yogurt
  7. Roll the chicken balls in the cornflake and seasoning mix
  8. Spray the chicken balls with oil
  9. Cook in the air fryer for 15-20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes

item.title: Hash Brown, Halloumi & Chorizo Hash
item.description:

item.title: High Protein Chicken Katsu Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

Chicken Katsu

  • Chicken breast - 600g (sliced or cubed)

  • Cornflakes or panko breadcrumbs - 80g
  • Oil spray

Fried Rice

  • Garlic - 2–3 cloves (minced)

Directions

  1. Coat chicken in egg and seasoning, then cover in crushed cornflakes or panko

  3. In a pan, scramble eggs and set aside
  4. Fry garlic in oil until fragrant
  5. Add rice, vegetables, and soy sauce, stirring well
  6. Return eggs and mix through

  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Fat - 12g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption and structure :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

item.title: High Protein Crispy Honey Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

Chicken

  • Diced boneless & skinless chicken breast - 1.05kg (raw weight)
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 35ml
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Potato starch - 100g
    • Approx. 40g adheres to chicken
  • Seasoning
    • Black pepper - 1/2 tsp
    • Onion powder - 1 tsp
    • Garlic powder - 1 tsp

Fried Rice

  • Frozen mixed vegetables - 500g
  • Eggs - 4
  • Egg whites - 200g
    • Or 5 whole eggs total
  • Spring onion / scallions (white part only) - 30g
  • Day old cooked white rice - 980g
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 40ml
  • Spring onion / scallions (green part only) - 20g

Honey Garlic Sauce

  • Garlic - 5 cloves (minced)
  • Salt reduced soy sauce - 60ml
  • Water - 60ml
  • Reduced sugar ketchup - 100g
  • Rice wine vinegar - 25ml
  • Cornflour - 1 tsp
  • Water - 80ml
  • Honey - 80g

Directions

  1. Place diced chicken in a bowl and combine with 35ml soy sauce, minced garlic, black pepper, onion powder and garlic powder
  2. Coat chicken with potato starch until evenly covered
  3. Cook chicken until crispy and cooked through (oven or air fryer)
  4. Prepare honey garlic sauce by combining garlic, soy sauce, water, ketchup, rice wine vinegar, cornflour slurry and honey
  5. Heat sauce gently until thickened
  6. In a large pan or tray, cook mixed vegetables with the white parts of the spring onion
  7. Add eggs and egg whites and cook until scrambled
  8. Add day-old rice and 40ml soy sauce, mixing thoroughly
  9. Fold through crispy chicken and green spring onion
  10. Pour over honey garlic sauce and mix until evenly coated
  11. Portion into 7 servings and serve

Notes

  • Caption-faithful reconstruction from reel ingredients
  • Uses potato starch to create crispy chicken coating
  • Day-old rice improves texture and prevents clumping
  • Designed as a high-protein meal prep recipe

item.title: High Protein Grilled Cheese Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 900g extra-lean beef mince
  • ½ white onion, diced
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • Taco seasoning
  • 400g canned diced tomatoes
  • 250ml chicken stock
  • 100g light cheddar
  • 600g cooked rice
  • Coriander
  • 6 large tortillas
  • 1 tbsp nacho cheese sauce per burrito
  • 20g light mozzarella per burrito

Directions

  1. Brown onion, garlic and beef, then add taco seasoning, tomatoes and stock.
  2. Simmer until the mixture is thick, then stir through cheddar and coriander.
  3. Divide rice, beef filling and nacho cheese sauce between tortillas and roll tightly.
  4. Place mozzarella in a hot non-stick pan and set the burrito on top.
  5. Cook until the cheese forms a crust, then turn and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe
